prd.title: Oracle-Healer: Self-Healing Wrapper for Oracle Loop
prd.target: Create resilient wrapper that auto-recovers from oracle-loop failures

executive_summary: The oracle-loop can fail for various infrastructure reasons (state file corruption, parsing failures, missing files) that require manual intervention. The Oracle-Healer is a wrapper script that catches these failures, spawns Claude to diagnose and fix the issue, then automatically restarts the loop. This enables truly autonomous operation with minimal human oversight.

whats_improved: Oracle loop three-phase cycle works correctly
State tracking via markdown files functional

current_failures.example: Escaped asterisks (\*\*Phase:\*\*) cause phase detection regex to fail
current_failures.root_cause: Claude sometimes escapes markdown when writing state files
current_failures.impact: Loop defaults to 'analyze' phase, triggers no-progress guardrail after 3 iterations

current_failures.example: When loop exits with code 1, it stays stopped until human restarts
current_failures.root_cause: oracle-loop.sh is designed to exit on unrecoverable errors
current_failures.impact: Autonomous improvement halts, requiring manual investigation and restart

current_failures.example: When failure occurs, error message is brief and logs are not analyzed
current_failures.root_cause: No structured failure context is captured for diagnosis
current_failures.impact: Manual debugging required to understand what went wrong

current_failures.example: If same failure repeats, loop keeps trying the same fix
current_failures.root_cause: No tracking of recovery attempts or failure patterns
current_failures.impact: Could burn tokens on repeated failed recovery attempts

features.name: Wrapper Script (oracle-healer.sh)
features.rationale: Core infrastructure that catches failures and orchestrates recovery
features.current_behavior: No wrapper exists; oracle-loop.sh exits on failure and stays stopped
features.proposed_behavior: Wrapper runs oracle-loop.sh, catches exit code 1, spawns Claude for diagnosis, restarts on successful fix

steps: Verify wrapper detects failure and captures exit code
Verify wrapper does not exit immediately
Check file contains failure type, exit code, timestamp
Check file contains last 100 lines of log
Verify Claude is invoked with PROMPT_diagnose.md
Check diagnostic log is created in logs/ directory
Verify Claude has access to failure context
Have Claude write HEALER_STATUS.md with ready_to_restart: true
Check loop continues from correct phase
Have Claude write HEALER_STATUS.md with ready_to_restart: false

changes.description: Create ~120 line bash script with: main loop, failure detection, context capture, Claude invocation, status checking, restart logic

features.name: Failure Type Detection
features.rationale: Different failure types require different diagnostic approaches
features.current_behavior: All failures treated identically as generic errors
features.proposed_behavior: Categorize failures into types: no_progress, missing_manifest, missing_prompt, claude_error, unknown

steps: Simulate Claude returning non-zero exit code

user_stories.description: Falls back to unknown for unrecognized errors

changes.description: grep log for known error patterns and set FAILURE_TYPE accordingly

features.name: Diagnostic Prompt (PROMPT_diagnose.md)
features.rationale: Claude needs structured guidance to investigate and fix infrastructure failures
features.proposed_behavior: Prompt instructs Claude to: read failure context, diagnose by type, apply minimal fix, signal status

steps: Verify Claude checks phase detection regex
Verify Claude checks for escaped asterisks
Verify Claude checks if file exists
Verify Claude attempts to restore from git
Run diagnostic prompt for any failure
Check file contains fix_applied or escalation_reason

user_stories.description: Prompt constrains Claude to meta-fixes only
steps: Verify Claude does NOT modify src/ files
Check only state files, oracle-loop.sh, or prompts modified

changes.description: Create ~100 line markdown prompt with: failure context reading, type-specific diagnosis steps, fix constraints, status output requirements

features.name: Recovery Attempt Limiting
features.rationale: Prevent infinite recovery loops that burn tokens without progress
features.proposed_behavior: Track recovery attempts, exit after 3 consecutive failed recoveries

steps: Trigger failure that cannot be auto-fixed
Verify counter increments after each recovery attempt
Check counter displayed in healer output
Verify healer exits after 3rd recovery attempt

user_stories.description: Counter resets after successful loop run
steps: Run oracle-loop to completion (or next failure)

changes.description: Add RECOVERY_ATTEMPTS counter, MAX_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTS constant, exit condition when exceeded

features.name: Status Signaling (HEALER_STATUS.md)
features.rationale: Wrapper needs structured way to know if Claude's fix succeeded
features.proposed_behavior: Claude writes HEALER_STATUS.md with ready_to_restart, fix_applied/escalation_reason, confidence

steps: Have Claude write HEALER_STATUS.md with ready_to_restart: true
Have Claude write HEALER_STATUS.md with ready_to_restart: false
Include escalation_reason: 'Cannot auto-fix API rate limit'
Verify wrapper displays this reason to user

changes.description: Read HEALER_STATUS.md, extract ready_to_restart and escalation_reason, handle missing file

success_metrics: Oracle-healer can recover from no-progress failures
Oracle-healer can recover from missing state files
Oracle-healer escalates appropriately after max attempts
Oracle-healer does not interfere with normal loop operation
Diagnostic logs capture sufficient context for debugging
